concepts.name: Recovery coordinator
passages: The recovery unit accepts municipal paper records damaged by clean water.
Every incoming crate is assigned an intake number before it enters the recovery wing.
The recovery coordinator may authorize use of the overflow drying room.
Weekend recovery shifts begin at eight in the morning.

concepts.name: Intake registrar
passages: The intake registrar records the originating department for every crate.
The intake registrar attaches a blue tag to each crate scheduled for freezing.
The intake registrar sends the daily crate list to the transport scheduler.
The daily crate list states the intake number and destination of each listed crate.
The intake registrar stores the original transfer forms in the intake cabinet.

concepts.name: Drying room supervisor
passages: The drying room supervisor assigns each crate accepted for drying to a drying rack.
The drying room supervisor sends the evening rack occupancy report to the recovery coordinator.
The evening rack occupancy report lists the rack numbers still holding records at six in the evening.
Only crates with written clearance from the collections conservator may leave the drying room.
The drying room supervisor keeps the key to the overflow drying room.

concepts.name: Facilities custodian
passages: The facilities custodian measures the relative humidity in the drying room at noon.
The facilities custodian enters the noon humidity reading in the room log.
If the noon humidity reading exceeds sixty percent, the facilities custodian asks the drying room supervisor to start the portable dehumidifier.
The drying room supervisor starts the portable dehumidifier when the facilities custodian requests it.

concepts.name: Collections conservator
passages: The collections conservator signs release slips for crates scheduled for freezing.
The collections conservator examines crates with visible mould before any drying treatment.
The collections conservator may issue written clearance for a crate to leave the drying room once its paper records are dry.
The collections conservator gives the intake registrar a copy of each signed release slip.
The collections conservator keeps the moisture meter in the locked assessment cupboard.

concepts.name: Transport scheduler
passages: The transport scheduler books the freezer van for crates with signed release slips.
The freezer van collects booked crates at four in the afternoon on weekdays.
The transport scheduler receives the daily crate list from the intake registrar and gives it to the freezer van driver before collection.
The transport scheduler telephones the recovery coordinator if the freezer van is delayed.
The freezer van driver and the facilities custodian both carry keys to the loading bay.
